decisions.reason: Although it is less central and only publicly mentioned, the launch-year investment and need to justify the existing commitment make withdrawal premature while early demand problems can be treated as temporary.
The firm has invested in multiple models in a line central to its waste-to-energy direction, and one-year disappointing results are attributed to temporary adoption and integration issues.
As the flagship presented on its own page, it carries the strongest public commitment and centrality, so escalation strongly favors persistence despite any early shortfalls.
Its stated flagship status and closeness to the established offer signal visible commitment, and early difficulties can still be framed as temporary scaling challenges.
